name: Ankheg

source.note: The 2024 Ankheg (2025 Monster Manual). Every number compared with the page fetched from aidedd.org (Monster Manual 2024 stat block). The Bite's Advantage against a creature it has Grappled is text only.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.summary: Burrows through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed, leaving a 10-ft tunnel.
traits.text: The ankheg can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed and leaves a tunnel 10 feet across behind it.

actions.name: Bite
actions.summary: A slashing, acid-slick bite that grabs a Large or smaller target (escape DC 13).
actions.text: Melee attack, +5 to hit, with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the ankheg. A Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Acid Spray
actions.summary: Recharge 6. A 30-ft line of acid: DC 12 Dex save, 4d6 Acid, half on a success.

summary: A burrowing brute that seizes prey in its jaws and spits a line of acid.
